verdict.rationale: Graphite keeps the core work in open, portable formats. The CLI is "fully compatible with git", stacking metadata lives in git refs, and agent changes are ordinary commits on GitHub branches. Leaving is therefore feasible, as community users switching to git spice or jujutsu suggest. However, nothing in the evidence documents a data-export feature for Graphite-held data such as insights metrics, AI review rules or chat history. Missing for 10: a documented export of Graphite-specific data (insights, review customizations, chat/agent history), stated open export formats, and hands-on evidence of a complete data export when offboarding.
